realSmoke.interpretation: Functional smoke only; not startup or speed qualification

currentAgentRepeatability.sourceScope: Frozen P2 worker before the later continuity-navigation repairs; actual source and worker manifests are retained. This is not a rerun of final formatted source.

historicalInputReconstruction.method: Frozen old host consumes recorded replies solely to reconstruct its six original envelopes; candidate prompt arrays and every Request payload byte are verified against historical records, except the protocol version. Actual candidate engines generate every replay output.

decision: Keep candidate unpromoted. Current-prefix parity passes, historical within-backend parity fails, common-prefix diagnostic masks match. No full performance cohort or automatic precision/context adoption.
